import os
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[k for k in c if k!=bg]
    # line color: color forming a full row or column
    line_color=None
    for col in colors:
        for r in g:
            if all(x==col for x in r): line_color=col
        for j in range(w):
            if all(g[i][j]==col for i in range(h)): line_color=col
    shape=[k for k in colors if k!=line_color][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==shape]
    lp=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==line_color]
    # direction from line to shape (dominant axis)
    li=sum(i for i,_ in lp)/len(lp); lj=sum(j for _,j in lp)/len(lp)
    si=sum(i for i,_ in pts)/len(pts); sj=sum(j for _,j in pts)/len(pts)
    import copy
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if abs(si-li)>=abs(sj-lj):  # vertical axis: line above -> 8 below
        i0=max(i for i,_ in pts)+1
        for j in range(w): out[i0][j]=8
    else:
        j0=max(j for _,j in pts)+1
        for i in range(h): out[i][j0]=8
    return out

demo_in=[[3]*20 for _ in range(14)]
for j in range(20): demo_in[3][j]=2
for i,j in [(4,5),(4,6),(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(5,7),(5,8),(5,9)]: demo_in[i][j]=5
exp=[r[:] for r in demo_in]
for j in range(20): exp[6][j]=8
print(transform(demo_in)==exp)
G=load()
out=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[k for k in c if k!=bg]
    line_color=None
    for col in colors:
        if any(all(x==col for x in r) for r in g) or any(all(g[i][j]==col for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)):
            line_color=col
    shape=[k for k in colors if k!=line_color][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==shape]
    horizontal = any(all(x==line_color for x in g[i]) for i in range(h))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if horizontal:
        li=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==line_color for x in g[i])][0]
        top=min(i for i,_ in pts); bot=max(i for i,_ in pts)
        if li<top:   # line above: move shape up to just below line
            shift=top-li-1
            for i,_ in pts: out[i][pts[0][1] if False else 0]=out[i][0]  # noop placeholder
            newpts=[(i-shift,j) for i,j in pts]
            for i,j in pts: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in newpts: out[i][j]=shape
            i0=max(i for i,_ in newpts)+1
            for j in range(w): out[i0][j]=8
        else:        # line below: move shape down to just above line
            shift=li-bot-1
            newpts=[(i+shift,j) for i,j in pts]
            for i,j in pts: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in newpts: out[i][j]=shape
            i0=min(i for i,_ in newpts)-1
            for j in range(w): out[i0][j]=8
    else:
        lj=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==line_color for i in range(h))][0]
        left=min(j for _,j in pts); right=max(j for _,j in pts)
        if lj<left:
            shift=left-lj-1
            newpts=[(i,j-shift) for i,j in pts]
            for i,j in pts: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in newpts: out[i][j]=shape
            j0=max(j for _,j in newpts)+1
            for i in range(h): out[i][j0]=8
        else:
            shift=right-lj-1
            newpts=[(i,j+shift) for i,j in pts]
            for i,j in pts: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in newpts: out[i][j]=shape
            j0=min(j for _,j in newpts)-1
            for i in range(h): out[i][j0]=8
    return out
